note: Every guide in trophies.json cites these sources by number. Each page was fetched and read on 20 November 2026. Of Zen and Computing was attempted but blocked by Cloudflare (HTTP 403), so it is not cited; PlanetGTA6 is the seventh source instead.

sources.depth: Full trophy guide with per-trophy methods and a 3-step roadmap. Primary source for counts (397 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, 14 drone locations, 40 races, 18 card sets, 9 gangs / 39 operations, 557 vehicles) and for the only exact methods for trophies 44, 45 and 50. Rates the platinum 4/10, about 200 hours, 1 playthrough.
sources.name: PowerPyx
sources.title: GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) Trophy Guide & Roadmap

sources.depth: Full 55-trophy list with grades, Gamerscore values and hidden flags, plus per-trophy unlock tips. Primary source for the chapter of each story trophy and for the 28-hidden count.
sources.name: GTABase
sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (PS5 & Xbox Series X|S)

sources.depth: Full list split into 27 visible and 28 hidden, with chapter-save advice and per-trophy notes. Disagrees with the majority on the hidden flag of trophies 30 and 47 (flips them); its VCIA gate detail (E3/E4) is the most specific for trophy 37.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements

sources.depth: Full list with a named 16-trophy hidden side section, a missable analysis and cross-source comparisons. Primary source for the Push Square disagreements (no known missables; 100% needs almost everything; trophy 47 not hidden) and for the per-strand detail on trophies 22-27 and 29.

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List: All 55, Missables and Roadmap

sources.depth: Full list with a 3-step platinum roadmap, per-trophy how-to lines and an unconfirmed-entries note. Primary source for the Strangers & Freaks strand list (trophy 25) and the WAiNK category counts (trophy 31).

sources.title: GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements
